name: Flat lay, slow overhead drift
summary: A top-down view of your flat lay with slowly changing daylight.
outcome: A top-down view of your flat lay with a slow camera drift and daylight changing gently across it.
photoGuidance: A photo taken from directly above.
Items laid flat with space between them.
limitations: Text and logos in your photo may change in the video. Check the result before you post it.

inputs.label: What's in the flat lay
inputs.help: For example, 'white shirt, belt and loafers'.

inputs.label: Details to keep as they are
inputs.help: Optional. For example, the colour of your cups or the shape of a sign.

inputs.label: Anything to leave out
inputs.help: Optional. For example, no smoke or no people.

prompt.preserve: Keep everything in the photo recognisable: the same objects, shapes, colours and proportions. Keep any printed text, labels and logos as they are.
prompt.avoid: Do not add people, hands, text, captions, logos or new objects. No sudden cuts, no camera shake, no warping or melting of surfaces.
prompt.subject: The photo is a top-down flat lay of {subject}.
prompt.composition: Keep the top-down view and the arrangement exactly as in the photo.
prompt.environment: The surface under the items stays as in the photo.
prompt.camera: The camera drifts very slowly across the arrangement, staying directly above it.
prompt.lighting: Daylight from a window, with soft shadows that shift slowly across the items.
